baseline_models.focus_anchor: The achieved predicate at word 2 is joined through man to the reflexive purification verb at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Success with lasting good and self-purification form an outcome-process relation: the successful subject is identified by actively bringing the self into purity and rectitude.

activation_trace.role: The durable-success branch supplies an achieved outcome that exceeds a momentary win.
The purity-and-rectitude branch supplies the reflexive transformation that characterizes the subject.

changed_reading.before: A person succeeds by becoming morally clean.
changed_reading.after: The ayah announces lasting good as already realized in the kind of person who actively brings the self into purity and rectitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two finite verbs connect the tilling image latent in word 2 with growth latent in word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A tiller opens worked ground so that increase can occur; read together, the branches make self-purification a cultivation process and success its viable yield.

activation_trace.role: The ground-splitting tiller supplies productive labor and prepared soil as the success mechanism.
The increase branch supplies the growth that answers cultivation rather than a merely subtractive cleansing.

changed_reading.before: Purification removes an impurity and is then rewarded with success.
changed_reading.after: Purification is self-cultivation: worked openness produces living increase, and falah names the resulting yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 can image an opening cut through constriction, while word 4 can image becoming suitable or fitting.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fitness and opening make a threshold model: as the subject makes the self apt for passage, a constricted route opens into successful emergence.

activation_trace.role: The cleaving branch supplies an opened way through material that had enclosed or narrowed it.
The fittingness branch makes the reflexive act an acquisition of aptitude for that passage.

changed_reading.before: Success is a possession awarded after purification.
changed_reading.after: Success is an emergence: self-fitting and the opening of a viable passage are two sides of the same event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening summons to worship and the post-focus remembering and prayer frame tazakka as an inward change that becomes enacted recognition, not private moral hygiene.

activation_trace.role: Durable success remains the focus outcome around which the worship frame closes.
Purity and rectitude anchor the inward side of the enacted sequence.
The worship branch supplies the initial imperative whose performance is resumed after the focus.
The naming branch supplies explicit designation as the object of both the opening summons and later remembrance.
Nurture, repair, and completion place self-rectification within an ongoing formative relation.
Remembrance passing onto the tongue supplies the outward articulation immediately after tazakka.
The specific worship branch supplies bodily practice as the completion of the post-focus sequence.

structural_cues: The imperative at 87:1 and completed verbs at 87:14-15 place the focus between summons and performance.
The sequence naming the Lord recurs at 87:1 and 87:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a worship-name-Lord frame and remembrance followed by prayer; I infer that the frame exposes the enacted face of tazakka. A live alternative is that 87:15 lists consequences rather than components of purification.

changed_reading.before: The subject privately purifies the self and thereby succeeds.
changed_reading.after: The subject's rectification becomes audible and bodily as naming, remembrance, and prayer within the Lord's formative care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, proportioning, measured limits, guidance, and nurturing growth turn the reflexive tazakka from autonomous self-production into maturation enabled by prior formation and direction.

activation_trace.role: The tiller supplies cultivation as a cooperative use of conditions not created by the crop itself.
Growth supplies the maturation whose agency the preceding sequence reassigns.
Nurture and completion supply a formative agency surrounding the subject's reflexive work.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes feeding and emergence, sharpening the maturation model without replacing the source root.
Measured formation supplies an antecedent design within which self-growth can become apt.
Integrity and completion supply a trajectory toward wholeness rather than mere removal.
A measure reaching its proper limit supplies bounded development rather than indefinite increase.
Gentle direction supplies the route by which measured potential becomes realized growth.

structural_cues: The repeated divine relative clause carries a chain of perfect verbs from formation through guidance before the focus.
The paired fa links at 87:2-3 present proportioning and guidance as directed sequels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formation, completion, measure, guidance, and nurture; I infer that they are enabling conditions for the later reflexive maturation. They could instead remain a cosmic prelude with no direct causal claim about tazakka.

changed_reading.before: Self-purification is an achievement manufactured by the isolated subject.
changed_reading.after: The subject participates reflexively in a measured, guided maturation whose conditions and direction precede the subject's own work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pasture is brought from concealment into growth and then made dark debris; against that cycle, tazakka cannot mean undifferentiated increase, but a purifying cultivation that distinguishes viable yield from growth destined to become residue.

activation_trace.role: The tiller anchors the focus in the same agricultural domain as pasture and its fate.
Increase supplies the initially positive growth that the decay sequence forces the reader to qualify.
Purification supplies selection or rectification within growth, preventing increase alone from defining success.
Emergence from concealment supplies the first phase of visible flourishing.
Pasture supplies the living crop and nourishment on which the cultivation model operates.
Transformation into another condition supplies the directional change from growth to spent matter.
Pasture reduced to dry debris supplies the failed endpoint of growth that does not endure.
Dark coloration makes the terminal state sensorially distinct from living increase.

structural_cues: The object brought out at 87:4 is pronominally carried into the transformation at 87:5.
The fa sequence compresses emergence and decay into one causal-temporal cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one pasture moving from emergence to dark debris; I infer that the focus's purity branch discriminates durable yield from perishable increase. The live alternative is that the vegetation cycle only illustrates mortality and does not define the mechanism of tazakka.

changed_reading.before: Any inward growth can count as purification and therefore as success.
changed_reading.after: Successful growth is cultivated and purified growth: increase is tested by what remains viable rather than by how lushly it first appears.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured constriction, guidance, and an opening into ease activate the focus as a route: becoming fit does not erase limits but permits movement through them into a viable way.

activation_trace.role: Cleaving supplies the passage opened through a narrow or resistant boundary.
Fittingness supplies the subject's acquired aptitude to traverse the opened route.
Narrowing something to a limited measure supplies the constricted geometry of the route.
Gentle indication supplies direction through the measured limit.
Opening and ease after difficulty supplies the destination and confirms that constriction is traversed, not denied.

structural_cues: At 87:3 measuring is immediately followed by guiding.
At 87:8 the doubled root joins facilitation to the easy course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies narrowing, direction, and ease-after-hardship; I infer a spatial route connecting them to the focus's cleaving and fitting branches. They may instead be independent descriptions of providential measure and ease.

changed_reading.before: Purification removes obstacles before success can begin.
changed_reading.after: Purification makes the subject fit for a guided passage through real limits, while falah is the opening and successful traversal of that passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation is retained against forgetting, made tractable, issued again as reminder, received as benefit, and recollected by the responsive subject; tazakka becomes a recursive retention-response process rather than a single cleansing event.

activation_trace.role: Lasting good supplies the persistence that the memory sequence explains operationally.
Rectification anchors the repeated cognitive and responsive operations in the focus.
Recitation and causing-to-recite supply the incoming content of the feedback process.
Loss of remembered content, negated in the source, supplies the failure mode against which retention is promised.
Light, tractable movement supplies the transition from retained content to ready practice.
Reminder as that which reactivates memory supplies the repeated input to other subjects.
Benefit supplies the criterion that distinguishes live reception from mere exposure.
Active recollection supplies the receiver's internal return of what the reminder presented.
Reverent fear supplies the receptive disposition that lets recollection alter conduct.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a promise of recitation and non-forgetting to an imperative to remind and a future recollection.
The relative subject man at 87:10 anticipates the relative subject man at 87:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receiving, non-loss, facilitation, reminder, benefit, recollection, and reverent responsiveness; I infer a feedback loop that realizes tazakka. A live alternative is that these actions prepare for purification without constituting it.

changed_reading.before: Tazakka is a one-time inward purge.
changed_reading.after: Tazakka is maintained through a loop of receiving, retaining, recalling, benefiting, and responding until rectitude becomes durable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge spans what is manifest and concealed, while remembrance and prayer give public form to the post-focus subject; tazakka therefore requires integrity between an inward state already exposed to knowledge and its outward enactment.

activation_trace.role: Success remains the focus judgment, now tested across hidden and manifest dimensions.
Purity anchors the internal condition whose congruence with outward action is at issue.
Disclosure to the knower supplies epistemic access that does not stop at performance.
Visible manifestation supplies the exterior pole of the integrity test.
Concealment supplies the interior pole that outward observance cannot substitute for.
Spoken remembrance gives the purified state an audible manifestation.
Worship gives that state a visible embodied manifestation.

structural_cues: At 87:7 the known field is explicitly polarized as the manifest and what is concealed.
At 87:15 remembrance and prayer immediately externalize the focus subject's orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive knowledge plus outward remembrance and prayer; I infer that success requires congruence between concealed state and manifest act. The alternative is that the knowledge statement concerns revelation generally and does not audit the focus subject.

changed_reading.before: Purification can be inferred from correct visible observance.
changed_reading.after: Purification is hidden-manifest integrity: voiced and embodied worship matters as the expression of an inward state, not as its replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The responsive subject recollects, while the wretched subject moves aside from reminder and reaches a state deprived of both death's release and life's benefit; the focus then names tazakka as the counter-trajectory of restored receptivity and living response.

activation_trace.role: Success with lasting good supplies the positive endpoint opposed to stalled nonlife.
Rectification supplies the inward turn that reverses evasive movement.
Recollection supplies the positive response available before the negative trajectory.
Reverent fear supplies responsiveness rather than flight.
Self-distancing and withdrawal supply the opposed movement away from reminder.
Wretchedness as the contrary of flourishing labels the subject produced by persistent avoidance.
Contact with consuming heat supplies the destination of the avoidance trajectory.
Loss of force and life, explicitly negated as completion, supplies one unavailable endpoint.
Life as benefit and good, also negated, supplies the positive capacity missing from the stalled state.

structural_cues: The responsive man of 87:10, the avoiding superlative subject of 87:11, and the successful man of 87:14 form contrasting subject trajectories.
The paired negations at 87:13 suspend the negative subject between two unavailable endpoints.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recollection, reverent response, withdrawal, wretchedness, heat, and suspended nonlife; I infer that tazakka reverses avoidance by restoring receptive capacity. The alternative is a simple contrast of destinies without a process account of purification.

changed_reading.before: Purification means withdrawing from contaminating objects.
changed_reading.after: Purification is not generalized avoidance: it is turning toward reminder and regaining the capacity to receive, recollect, and enact life-giving good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference selects the proximate life, while the later domain is named more beneficial and more enduring; this makes tazakka a reordering of valuation across time and makes falah the durable result of choosing beyond immediacy.

activation_trace.role: Lasting good supplies the focus criterion that the following comparison explicitly confirms.
Rectification supplies the internal reordering needed to resist a merely proximate preference.
Deliberate preference supplies the choice operation whose criterion must be purified.
Life construed as benefit supplies the attractive good being evaluated rather than treating the near life as valueless.
Proximity supplies the immediacy bias that makes the nearer benefit disproportionately salient.
Deferral to a later time supplies the competing horizon that preference tends to discount.
Beneficial good supplies qualitative superiority rather than duration alone.
Continuance supplies temporal superiority and resolves the lasting component of falah.

structural_cues: Bal at 87:16 reverses from the successful worship sequence to a plural preference diagnosis.
The coordinated comparatives at 87:17 evaluate the later domain by both benefit and duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, proximity, laterness, benefit, and endurance; I infer that tazakka purifies the chooser's time horizon. The alternative is that 87:16-17 describe a consequence of impurity without specifying how tazakka works.

changed_reading.before: Purification concerns the moral quality of isolated acts.
changed_reading.after: Purification recalibrates preference itself, allowing a real but near benefit to be judged against a better and more enduring horizon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because rare bodily-cleft branches are being connected to an ethical predicate; it remains anchored in the focus cleft image and is activated by the packet's lip, voice, and tongue images; render it only as an articulatory resonance, never as the lexical definition of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cleft branch of word 2 can become an aperture image while the purity branch of word 4 governs what passes through it.

activation_trace.role: The lip-cleft branch supplies a bodily aperture directly anchored in the success verb.
The cutting-open branch lets the aperture function as release rather than defect alone.
Purity governs the quality of the utterance imagined as passing through the opened mouth.
A second visible lip-cleft image makes the bodily activation recurrent rather than isolated.
Raised or announced sound supplies the voiced material moving through the aperture.
Remembrance flowing on the tongue supplies the purified speech released after the focus.

changed_reading.before: Success and purification have no bodily articulation in the focus.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the purified subject is imaged as an opened mouth through which concealed orientation becomes voiced remembrance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split-root overlap between meeting fire and prayer/following; it remains anchored in the focus as the pivot between the two neighboring trajectories; render it as a sound-and-branch reversal, not as proof that the two contextual verbs are semantically identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus stands between the fire-contact sequence at 87:12-13 and the remembrance-prayer sequence at 87:15, with opening and rectitude providing the pivot.

activation_trace.role: Opening supplies the turn out of one trajectory and into another.
Rectification supplies the reorientation that differentiates the two forms of contact.
Meeting heat supplies the consuming contact immediately before the focus.
Specific worship supplies the transformed contact immediately after the focus.
The non-dominant following image recasts prayer as alignment behind a preceding guide rather than exposure to consuming heat.

changed_reading.before: The fire before the focus and prayer after it are unrelated outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The focus can function as a reversal of contact: purification turns a trajectory of meeting consuming heat into one of remembered worship and guided following.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote pair/even branch of the focus root; it remains anchored in tazakka and gains patterned support from the packet's manifest/hidden, death/life, and near/later pairs; render it as a structural analogy about ordering paired dimensions, not as a direct gloss of tazakka.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pair branch at word 4 can organize the focus's purification around recurring contextual dyads while durable success at word 2 supplies their right ordering.

activation_trace.role: Durable success supplies the criterion by which paired horizons are ordered.
The pair-and-even branch supplies the unusual structural lens directly from the focus verb.
Manifest visibility supplies one member of an epistemic pair.
Concealment supplies the paired interior member.
Loss of life supplies one existential pole.
Life as good supplies the opposed existential pole.
Nearness supplies the immediate member of the temporal pair.
Laterness supplies the temporally opposed member.

changed_reading.before: Purification works by eliminating one side of every opposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, purification rightly orders paired dimensions: hidden with manifest, mortal life with true benefit, and the near horizon with the later one.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps tillage and growth onto broad written sheets and inherited recurrence; it remains anchored in both focus roots and in the packet's post-focus writing, beginning, outcome, and succession images; render it as a cross-domain transmission model, not as a claim that the scrolls are literally agricultural fields.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The tiller at word 2 and growth at word 4 permit the inherited written record after the focus to behave imagistically like a repeatedly cultivated field.

activation_trace.role: The tiller supplies cultivation as repeated work on a receptive surface.
Growth supplies the recurring yield produced in successive readers or communities.
Breadth and extension supply the receptive surface of the textual field.
The written sheet keeps the field explicitly textual and prevents the analogy from floating free.
Beginning and precedence supply the inherited starting layer of cultivation.
Return to outcome supplies recurrence in which an old inscription reaches a fresh realization.
The non-dominant succession image supplies transmission from one instantiation to the next.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an isolated individual's successful purification.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the individual is a fresh growth of an old textual cultivation whose pattern is replanted across successive records and recipients.

strongest_changes: Self-purification became enabled maturation within prior nurture, measure, formation, and guidance rather than isolated self-manufacture.
The pasture-to-debris cycle revised growth into discriminating cultivation whose success is tested by viable yield.
Recitation, retention, reminder, recollection, and worship made tazakka a recursive and embodied practice rather than a one-time purge.
The near/later comparison exposed purification as a recalibration of preference toward better and more enduring good.
summary.what_was_special: The focus held several coexisting mechanisms: durable rectitude, agricultural yield, opened passage, memory feedback, hidden-manifest integrity, and temporal choice. Non-dominant split-root branches also activated nurturing growth, guided following, visible marking, succession, and several contained bodily or textual images without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax leaves live whether tazakka causes falah, identifies the successful subject, or names one phase of the same event.
The vegetation cycle may define purification as selective cultivation, or may only supply a mortality contrast.
The causal link from divine formation and guidance to reflexive self-work is abductive rather than grammatically explicit.
The oral-aperture, fire-prayer, paired-order, and scriptural-field readings should remain qualified resonances because their branch distances are materially greater.
